source: Allard & Atalla 2e Table 12.4, PDF page 304 (printed p. 299)
about: Table 12.4, "The parameters of the plate-fibre system": a 1 m x 1 m, 3 mm aluminium plate with an attached limp porous layer, excited by a point force (Figures 12.9 to 12.12). Columns as printed: thickness h (mm), phi, sigma (N s/m4), alpha_inf, Lambda (um), Lambda' (um), rho_1 (kg/m3), E (Pa), nu and eta_s. The limp foam is the foam of Tables 11.5 and 12.1 printed without elastic constants, because the example models it as limp. The panel row, 2742 kg/m3, E 6.9e10, nu 0.3, eta 0.01, is not a porous material and is not here.
